author: Upsoar
body:
I've seen this implemented on a few pvp server's. XP is given to players who say "gg" in chat right after a game is ended. I think that this being added would help create a better attitude towards players after a game. Many times, I do see players upset when they loose and tend to be disrespectful in chat. This would give them a good incentive to be a good team sport instead of raging after a game. (plus; who doesn't like free XP! :D)
*Note : It would be a very small amount of XP
